items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: after that Ellis Stratigas's Two Sighs, that's strictly a big commercial band

ctx.x: that's funny. Is there any other records that you were on, early records?
Well, after that Ellis Stratigas's Two Sighs, that's strictly a big commercial band. Although it had the sound of a New Orleans band, it sounded sort of like the Owls, you remember?
